articles.title: BSC’s quantum defense works. The trade-off is 40% slower transaction throughput.

articles.title: World Liberty Financial treasury company AI Financial warns that it may not survive the year in SEC filing
articles.snippet: The former Alt5 Sigma marked its 7.28 billion WLFI tokens at $706 million, down from a roughly $1.46 billion cost basis, while disclosing that the holdings remain locked amid liquidity concerns.

articles.title: Estonian regulator partially suspends Zondacrypto operator license
articles.snippet: Estonia’s FIU has partially suspended BB Trade Estonia OÜ’s license, giving the Zondacrypto operator 30 days to fix compliance issues or risk full revocation.
